atoms.text: Cherry works at an aquarium. This table shows how many of each type of fish there are at the aquarium.

instruction.text: Order the fish from most to least fish at the aquarium.
Answer the following questions using the table.

atoms.a: How many clownfish are there at the aquarium?
How many starfish are there at the aquarium?
How many sharks are there at the aquarium?
How many angelfish are there at the aquarium?
What is the difference between the number of clownfish and the number of sharks?
How many more starfish are there than angelfish?
How many fish are there in total at the aquarium?
